title: Smooth unit normal in A₀ of an oriented smooth stationary hypersurface, with zero mean curvature (parent steps 2 and 3)
statement: Unit normal and minimality. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; U ⊆ ℝ^P; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P. Hypotheses: U is open; M ⊆ U; dim A₀ = m + 1; M ⊆ A₀; M is an embedded C^r m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P for every r ∈ ℕ; M has an orientation (IsOrientation m M ξ for some ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P): ξ is continuous on M and ξ(x) = ±τ_1∧⋯∧τ_m for an orthonormal basis τ of tangentSpace M x); H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; and M is stationary in U: ∫_M div_M X dH^m = 0 for every C¹ X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport X ⊆ U (div_M X(x) := trace(P_x∘DX(x)), P_x the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x), H^m = μHE[m]). Conclusion: there are ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P and an open set O ⊇ M such that ν is C^∞ on O (ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) and, for every x ∈ M: ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1, ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x, and trace(P_x∘Dν(x)) = 0, where Dν(x) = fderiv ℝ ν x (that is, div_M ν = 0: the mean curvature of M vanishes).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → (∃ ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m, IsOrientation m M ξ) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0) → ∃ (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P) (O : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ ν x).toLinearMap) = 0
